mapper.sql: SELECT p.bsn_part_id,p.bsn_part_nm,p.hq_yn,p.use_yn,p.sort_seq, (SELECT count(*) FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt > #{today})) AS "peopleCount", (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.prj j WHERE j.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND j.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD')) AS "projectCount" FROM mst.bsn_part p
mapper.select: SELECT rows.*,c.ldr_nm,c.prft_dstrb_rt,c.bsn_fee_amt,c.aply_bgn_ym FROM () rows LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.ldr_nm,s.prft_dstrb_rt,s.bsn_fee_amt,s.aply_bgn_ym FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist s WHERE s.bsn_part_id=rows.bsn_part_id AND s.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (s.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR s.aply_end_ym >= #{month}) ORDER BY s.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT aply_bgn_ym,ldr_nm,prft_dstrb_rt,bsn_fee_amt,part_std_hist_id,aply_end_ym, CASE WHEN aply_bgn_ym > #{month} THEN '예정' WHEN aply_end_ym IS NULL OR aply_end_ym >= #{month} THEN '적용 중' ELSE '지난 기준' END AS status FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC,part_std_hist_id DESC
SELECT max(cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE mst.bsn_part IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_nm=#{name})
INSERT INTO mst.bsn_part(bsn_part_nm,hq_yn,sort_seq,use_yn,created_by) SELECT #{input.bsn_part_nm},'N',COALESCE(max(sort_seq),0)+1,'Y',#{actor} FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE hq_yn='N' RETURNING bsn_part_id
